elements.text:
Your crush hasn't responded in a few days. After long deliberation, you send a double text. 

Here are some feelings that might happen in the moment:

texts: I'm relieved to have followed up.
I'm proud that I did something that scared me.
I'm a little embarassed, but remind myself that reaching out is not something to be ashamed of.
I feel immediate regret and wish I could unsend it.
I feel vulnerable, but know that vulnerability is an important part of developing connection.
